{{Nihongo|Sebastian|セバスチャン|Sebasuchan}}''' '''is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon: DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]].''

Sebastian is [[Romana (DS)|Romana]]'s long time personal friend and butler. He lives at the villa with Romana and her granddaughter [[Lumina (DS)|Lumina]]. Although he is a butler, he is treated kindly by Romana and Lumina, and is considered a part of their family. He has been Romana's butler since he was very young.

He spends most of his time in the villa's kitchen or garden. He secretly loves art, and loves gardening.
